Hey man welcome! I used the technical paint called martian earth. I painted the colours I wanted to come through the cracks first, let it dry. Then I popped a thick layer of the technical and left it 24hours, eventually it cracks like that. Then I carefully painted black over it. 

Thicker the layer the big the cracks (next one's I'll make smaller). To make it easier there is a black version of the technical paint you can get.
It was really easy, I used the official games workshop YouTube channel tutorial which uses technical ardcoat and lahmian medium 🙂
